hits.title: AArete Names Healthcare Leader Pam Shipley as CEO - AArete
hits.snippet: AArete Names Healthcare Leader Pam Shipley as CEO - AArete ... CHICAGO–(BUSINESS WIRE)– AArete, a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member.
